description: Base configuration shared by aetos382's repositories
Updates wait 3 days after release (minimumReleaseAge), except pins and vulnerability fixes
Vulnerability fixes are labeled `security` and follow the same automerge rules as other updates
Minor and patch updates of the Renovate CLI (npm package `renovate`) are automerged when its version is marked with a `# renovate:` comment
`_VERSION` variables in Dockerfiles and GitHub Actions files are updated when marked with a `# renovate:` comment

packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch/pin/digest updates for trusted GitHub Actions
Auto-merge minor/patch updates of the Renovate CLI pinned with a `# renovate:` comment. It only validates the Renovate configuration
Don't automerge major updates. Rules in repositories come after this, so they must not enable automerge without matchUpdateTypes
